title: How do I get started with augo as a coach?
seoTitle: Getting Started With augo as a Coach | augo support
description: Create your coach account, connect your first athletes and set up feedback. augo is free for up to 2 athletes.
summary: Sign in to the web app at webapp.augotraining.com, or use the mobile app. Add your first athletes, ask them to connect a device, and choose the session-feedback questions you want. Up to 2 athletes is free, permanently.

body.html: augo gives coaches full access on both web and mobile. Most coaches do their planning and review on the web app and use mobile for day-to-day messaging and workout review.

Create your account

Coaches sign in at webapp.augotraining.com, or download the mobile app from the App Store or Google Play. The same account works across all three.

Add your first athletes

Your roster is the centre of augo — almost everything else keys off it. Up to 2 athletes is free permanently, so you can run a real coaching relationship before deciding whether to pay.

Ask athletes to connect a device

Workout data flows in once each athlete connects Garmin, Polar, Strava, Coros, Wahoo or Zwift from their own account. Until they do, their training feed will be empty. This is the single most common reason a new roster looks broken.

Choose your feedback questions

Decide what augo asks your athletes after each session. Three questions are always asked; the rest are yours to pick.

Then let it build context

augo gets more useful as it accumulates conversations, feedback and workouts. The daily priority list in particular needs about a week of data before it has a baseline to compare against.

faqs.question: Do I need to install an app to coach on augo?
faqs.answer: No. Coaches have full access through the web app at webapp.augotraining.com. The mobile apps are there for messaging and reviewing workouts on the go, but nothing is web-only or mobile-only for coaches.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to start?
faqs.answer: Nothing. Up to 2 athletes is free permanently — not a time-limited trial. You only pay when you go to 3 or more.
